description: Expose a port from a sandbox and get a public preview URL. Useful when an agent starts a web server it wants to show.

session_id.description: Sandbox session id (UUID), from tenki_create_sandbox or tenki_list_sandboxes.

slug.description: Subdomain slug for the preview URL (3-63 chars, lowercase letters/digits/hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen).

name: tenki_expose_port
